answer_1.quote: We study preference-controlled text generation for the task of instruction following and keyword-focused document summarization.

answer_2.quote: We utilize the recent state-of-the-art reward model, ArmoRM-Llama3-8B-v0.1. For summarization, we simulate rewards by comparing summaries to the ground truth using average F1 scores from Rouge-1, -2, and -L.

answer_3.quote: We use the recent state-of-the-art reward model, ArmoRM-Llama3-8B-v0.1, and UltraRM-13B (a Llama-2-13B model tuned with GPT-4 preference feedback) to evaluate generated outputs.
